The issuer shows strong profitability with an operating margin of 41% (operating income of 1,307M on revenue of 3,198M) and a net income of 734M. However, its financial profile carries significant risk, characterized by a highly leveraged balance sheet (total liabilities of 43,578M against total assets of 58,573M, resulting in an equity base of 12,807M), negative retained earnings of -12,237M, and a weak short-term liquidity position with a current ratio of 0.53 (current assets of 3,244M versus current liabilities of 6,106M). These mixed factors, combining strong earnings generation with constrained liquidity and high leverage, support a non-investment grade rating in the BB range.

DECISION: BB-
